gate_title: Post-PYT deterministic canonical pytest shard cutover

current_authority.canonical_complete_suite: PYTHONPATH=src:. python3 -m pytest tests -q --tb=short remains the serial required canonical execution in job/context tests

proposed_authority_delta.activate: Replace only the serial canonical pytest execution topology behind the existing required tests context with the qualified deterministic four-shard exact-current-pytest union and aggregate.
proposed_authority_delta.shard_semantics: one pytest session per shard; exact manifest selection after canonical pytest collection; no xdist; fail closed on missing, duplicate, reordered or mismatched identities
proposed_authority_delta.duplicate_research_console_rerun: May be removed only as the already-demonstrated redundant second explicit rerun after recursive pytest tests coverage is retained; no test identity may be omitted from the canonical union.
proposed_authority_delta.shadow_workflow: May remain as non-required historical/requalification infrastructure; no deletion is authorized.
not_included: required context rename, retirement or GitHub ruleset mutation
retirement of pytest/unittest parity or runner parity
removal or weakening of profile assurance, SIQ READY, VIT, GRT, PDC or OVC merge-readiness semantics
scientific, semantic, selector, family, Validation, publication, probability, risk, exposure, trading, execution or agent-write authority

performance_evidence.interpretation: The qualified execution topology materially reduces test execution critical path. End-to-end wall reduction is smaller because shadow runs independently bootstrap runners, install dependencies, collect the full population, upload artifacts and aggregate; PASS does not authorize weakening those assurance semantics to chase latency.

warnings: The execution critical-path gain is about 55-56%, while observed shadow workflow wall is 236-265 seconds because per-job bootstrap/install/collection/artifact overhead remains.
Heavy-path seed assignment is operational scheduling metadata only; it grants no scientific or test-selection authority.
Diagnostic PR #1310 is read-only/non-authoritative and must not merge.
Required-context name/ruleset mutation is outside this PASS. If the implementation cannot preserve the existing tests context, stop rather than widen authority.
The echo-only tiered compatibility context is not retired by this PASS; SIQ READY and merge-readiness semantics remain intact.

external_artifact_hashes.artifact: common raw manifest bytes across 10 relied-on files

rollback: If PASS implementation fails or later regresses, forward-revert/supersede the cutover so the existing tests required context again executes the current serial PYTHONPATH=src:. python3 -m pytest tests -q --tb=short path. Preserve parity, profile assurance, SIQ/VIT/GRT/PDC/merge-readiness, every qualification artifact and Git history. Do not delete evidence, force-push or rewrite history.
exact_work_after_pass: Create one bounded cutover implementation branch from then-current lawful main.

Modify the current required tests workflow so the qualified deterministic manifest and four one-session pytest shards execute the exact current pytest collection; the aggregate retains the existing required job/context identity tests.
Do not introduce xdist, multi-process pytest semantics, a new PR listener, a required-context rename or a ruleset mutation.
Remove only the explicitly redundant second tests/research_console_vnext rerun if recursive pytest tests coverage is re-proven in the cutover tests; otherwise preserve it.
Preserve pytest/unittest parity, runner parity, profile assurance, SIQ READY, VIT/GRT/PDC and OVC merge-readiness semantics unchanged.
Run targeted workflow/shard-governance tests, canonical collection/equivalence tests, repository-wide tests and exact-final VIT/SIQ/GRT/PDC/merge-readiness.
If the aggregate cannot preserve the existing tests required-context identity, or any fixture/session/order semantic diverges, stop without widening the PASS and return to the operator.
When all approved cutover acceptance conditions pass with authority confined to this delta, materialise cutover QA/state and use the normal eligible integration path.
exact_work_after_defer: Leave current serial required CI unchanged and preserve the qualified shadow evidence; optionally collect further comparable overhead/runner data before presenting a superseding cutover decision.
exact_work_after_block_or_quarantine: Keep the current serial canonical tests path authoritative, preserve all shadow evidence, and record the blocking disposition without deleting branches, workflows or artifacts.
